nodes.label: Pastel Card Tints
nodes.rationale: Echo the colorful database properties of the live Notion product

nodes.label: Link Blue (#0075de)
nodes.rationale: Inline links only, never mixed with primary purple

nodes.label: Notion Purple Primary (#5645d4)
nodes.rationale: Reserved for the dominant CTA only; distinct role from link-blue

nodes.label: Border Radius Scale
nodes.rationale: 8px rectangular buttons (not pills) give sober editorial geometry; 12px for all cards

nodes.label: Typography Tokens (Notion Sans)
nodes.rationale: Inter-based humanist-geometric face pairs with colorful illustrations; must not be replaced by generic Inter

nodes.label: Firebase Anonymous Auth Session
nodes.rationale: Exists only to satisfy database rules requiring auth != null for protected writes; not the identity source

nodes.label: Email/Password Direct Login
nodes.rationale: Login no longer depends on a custom token route; email is the unique identifier

nodes.label: Local Session (localStorage)
nodes.rationale: Stores email, roll, name, expiry; drives UI fast checks and redirects, not a security source of truth

nodes.label: Firebase RTDB users node
nodes.rationale: Read publicly by the client; tolerates users/{email} and users/{id} record shapes

nodes.label: Firebase RTDB metadata store (last-197cd)
nodes.rationale: Reuses existing firebase-admin service account; no extra env vars

nodes.label: Local tunnel (ngrok / Cloudflare)
nodes.rationale: Google cannot deliver webhooks to localhost

nodes.label: Drive Page Token (drive/meta/pageToken)
nodes.rationale: Advanced only after all changes.list pages processed so duplicate webhook deliveries are harmless

nodes.label: revalidateTag("drive") invalidation
nodes.rationale: Idempotent; invalidates ALL folders since changes are rare, avoiding tracking a cached-folder set

nodes.label: Next.js unstable_cache (tag drive)
nodes.rationale: Vercel-native shared cache; dedupes rebuilds so no locks or version counter needed; 12h revalidate fallback so data never freezes
